Good day, everyone!

I am from the Philippines and I visited Israel to visit my boyfriend last June 2026 and I’m planning to visit again this October of this year. I applied for an ETA-IL last June, and it says that it’s valid until 2028.

I’m just confused if I still need to apply for another one since I’ve already used it, or if I can use the same authorization for my return trip.

I would highly appreciate your responses. Toda raba! 🙏
